title: Metallographic cross-section report MR-26-0912
excerpt: Weld penetration depth at 3 o'clock: 0.42 mm (spec min 0.60 mm). Positions 6/9/12 o'clock within spec (0.71-0.78 mm). Indicates local loss of laser power or focus shift at seam start.

candidate_causes.description: Protective glass contamination on laser optic reduced power at seam start (3 o'clock)
five_why: Laser power at workpiece below setpoint at seam start
Glass change interval based on time, not on power monitoring
candidate_causes.validation_plan: Measure power at workpiece with calibrated power meter before/after glass change; cross-section 5 parts each condition
candidate_causes.proposed_action: Install laser power monitoring at workpiece with interlock and change protective glass on power drop

candidate_causes.description: Fixture clamping gap at inlet tank position 3 o'clock exceeding 0.1 mm
five_why: Gap between tank and core plate
candidate_causes.validation_plan: Gap measurement with feeler gauge on fixture 2 vs fixture 1; 30 parts
